g.title: notes
g.text: Synthetic prototype only. Phase 1 role previews simulate navigation, not authentication.
Family linkage grants no medical access. Clinical rules are unvalidated; no autonomous diagnosis.
Phases: 1 Foundation | 2 Secure records & consent | 3 Intelligence & family sharing | 4 Verify & deploy

g.title: token
g.text: One use, one facility, limited scope
